title: The Morning Digest: November 16, 2026
dek: Brent Jan27 was $95.30 at 0427 GMT on Monday, down $0.54 or 0.6 percent, and WTI Dec26 was $88.34, down $0.22 or 0.3 percent (Reuters, Nov 16), taking the Brent to WTI spread to $6.96 after two straight settles above $7. UKMTO reported a tanker attacked in the Arabian Gulf on Sunday, identified by Vanguard Tech as the VLCC Al Dhannah, and alerted a second vessel struck by an unknown projectile outbound through the strait at 0558 UTC on Monday, with an engine room fire and all crew accounted for. Iranian claims of two mine strikes and a VLCC sinking on Sunday remain unconfirmed, with no vessel named. December WCS is -$28.27 (ICE TMW settle, Nov 13) on zero lots. The validated diesel crack is $91.24.

Nov 16, 2026 (UKMTO cited Indian shipping authorities reporting a tanker attacked in the Arabian Gulf approaching the strait on Nov 15, crew safe; Vanguard Tech identified the vessel as the Thenamaris-operated VLCC Al Dhannah, struck in the steering gear room and returning toward Dubai, on the PGSA non-compliant list; the IRGC claimed two tankers struck mines in the southern corridor and a VLCC carrying over 2 million barrels sank, posting video showing fire and smoke on water with no discernible vessel, neither vessel identified and no independent verification; UKMTO alerted on Nov 16 that a vessel was struck by an unknown projectile outbound at 0558 UTC with an engine room fire, crew accounted for and no casualties, identified by Vanguard as the Panama-flagged On Phoenix about 3 nautical miles off Oman, on the PGSA blacklist since Sep 14)

Nov 16, 2026 (shipping through the strait slowed over the weekend after attacks on tankers, with traffic described as nearly ground to a halt after the UAE announcement that three ADNOC-operated vessels came under attack the previous week; US-Iran talks stalled; Iran's foreign minister said Washington must meet Iran's conditions on the strait for shipping to resume; on Sunday night Iran's navy said an oil tanker caught fire after striking a naval mine east of the strait, and Reuters could not independently verify the report)
